seed: The last guide of the Icons track: the bell leaves the app still ringing. It opens on the finished icon, with the clapper arriving after the body, explains what the Export sheet asks BEFORE it is opened so nobody reads a card laid over the thing it describes, and only the last card points at the sheet itself. The walk picks the frame from the layers list rather than by clicking its name on the canvas, because the name is chrome drawn in view space and the walk writes its points in document space; the event the step waits for is the same either way. It also writes the file the app writes, so the audit can show what really lands on disk and what is in it.

steps.note: the finished bell: two parts, the clapper arriving after the body, and the whole of it made of shapes rather than pixels.
the frame picked, which is what Export opens on, so the file is the icon and not the page round it

THE TEST the acceptance asks for: the file the app writes, written. The log line above says how big it is and how many moving parts are in it. There is no picture inside it, so the icon stays sharp at every size and a browser can play it with nothing else loaded.
the card asks for Export and waits for the sheet rather than for a Next press

THE TEST: the sheet coming up moved the guide on by itself, and the last card points at the SHEET, so it sits beside it rather than over the destination row it is talking about. The sheet asks where the file is going before it asks for a format, and lists what survives the trip.
